entities.name: Agustín Ubal

entities.summary: Agustín Ubal Agostini is a Uruguayan professional basketball player who plays for Bàsquet Manresa of the Spanish Liga ACB. Standing at 6 ft 8 inches, Ubal can play as a guard and small forward. He also has Italian citizenship.
